articles.summary: For the over 60% of Americans 65 and older who are overweight or obese, GLP-1 drugs are a potential game changer. But for many Americans, the high cost of these medications is a barrier to use, including limited access through Medicare plans.
articles.title: GLP-1 drugs and Medicare: How beneficiaries can save on these blockbuster medications
